svg.aria-label: Five projects: LOGIS and IRIS at PITD, OPIS thesis, OASIS at DICT, and a Raspberry Pi school bell

g.text: 01 / LOGIS / LOGISTICS, ORDER, AND GOODS INVENTORY SYSTEM
Built at PITD for the Provincial General Services Office to manage purchase orders and bodega deliveries.
Tracks received stock and open balances, with audit history and printable pickup notices.
PLGU NUEVA VIZCAYA · NEXT.JS · NESTJS · TYPESCRIPT · PRISMA · SQL SERVER
02 / IRIS / ICT RESOURCES INVENTORY SYSTEM
Built at PITD to digitize device inventories, accountable personnel, installed software, and sign-offs.
Supports guided entry, audited corrections, licensing and subscription reports, and Excel exports.
PLGU NUEVA VIZCAYA · NEXT.JS · NESTJS · TYPESCRIPT · PRISMA · SQL SERVER
03 / OPIS / ONLINE PROVINCIAL INVENTORY SYSTEM
Led the thesis team and full-stack development of an inventory platform for PLGU Nueva Vizcaya.
Built office-scoped access, real-time updates, requisitions, reporting, and Google Drive backups.
THESIS · NEXT.JS · NESTJS · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · PRISMA · SOCKET.IO · PUPPETEER · EXCELJS
04 / OASIS / OFFICE ASSET SERVICES INVENTORY SYSTEM
Developed an inventory and deployment system during my DICT Nueva Vizcaya internship.
Implemented audit trails, role-based access, deployment workflows, and asset notifications.
DICT NUEVA VIZCAYA · NEXT.JS · NESTJS · TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · PRISMA
05 / AUTOMATED PROGRAMMABLE SCHOOL BELL SYSTEM
Programmed a Raspberry Pi controller with a Tkinter interface for daily and emergency bell schedules.
Set up relay control, saved schedules, and configured the hardware and real-time clock.
EMBEDDED SYSTEMS · PYTHON · TKINTER · RASPBERRY PI 4 · RPI.GPIO
